_comment: Account-specific context, supplied by whoever is running the audit.
Nothing in here can be inferred from a workflow export — it is what the
person who designed the account knows and the JSON does not. Every key is
optional; an empty config is valid, it just means more checks report as
A bundle can also carry the same block under a top-level "config" key,
which is what examples/broken-account.json does so the demo runs in one
command. A --config file on the command line replaces that block.
